_source.rule: Copied byte-for-byte from the recorded real pass (never edited). See src/lib/pinned.ts.

recording.what: A real pass made by the app's own example warm-up (warmExamples in src/lib/prewarm.ts, the function the server starts at boot), run for this one example park: White Rock Lake Park, ages 6-10, Gemma 4 (gemma-4-31B-it) on DigitalOcean, live iNaturalist, the saved OpenStreetMap snapshot. Its first attempt of the day: 8 of 8 finds and a Find This Spot riddle written by the model. Read back from the pass store with loadPass, never edited.
recording.recordedBy: builder AH (pin-examples), app code at commit 3540d0c, local Node process (scratch Vitest harness calling warmExamples({ examples: [white-rock] })), in-memory store
recording.note: SERPAPI_DAILY_CAP=2 on this run, so the warm-up share of SerpApi was 1 search; it went to Arbor Hills (made first), so this pass has no Lucky Finds block.

items.clue: Where are the 3 areas with a dirt mound in the middle?
Which one pours water into a bowl? Listen for its splish-splashing sound!
items.safety: Stay with your grown-up near water.

items.clue: Hunt for a long seat with bench seats attached.
Check for a play spot with things to slide down.
Notice a metal cooker on a stand that is dark from smoke.
Somewhere you will see a thin spurt of water leap from a spout?
Watch for a bug with a chunky white body and checkered wings!
items.safety: Look, don't touch. Stay with your grown-up near water.

items.clue: Peek at a bird with a black head, white cheeks, and brown body.
items.safety: Watch from far away. Never chase or touch. Stay with your grown-up near water.

lucky.message: Lucky Finds: not on this example pass. Grass Pass keeps at least half of each day's free visitor-review searches (SerpApi) for passes people make, and the example passes used their share today.

pass.parentNote: Start with find 3: it's easy and it stays put. Finds 2, 7 and 8 are near water: stay close.
